about_the_game:
🚗 Why Is Driving So Hard? is a chaotic driving game that will test your patience, your reflexes… and your friendships!

Forget realistic simulators: here you’ll have to master your keyboard and mouse to drive in the most absurd and challenging way possible. Each level is full of ridiculous obstacles that turn even the simplest path into a true odyssey on wheels.

🎮 Key Features:

  • Drive solo or with friends: face challenges alone or in multiplayer filled with laughter and unexpected crashes.

  • Overcome impossible obstacles: giant rocks, insane jumps, and tricky paths that will make you hate driving.

  • Customize your character: equip fun accessories to give your driver a unique style.

  • Laugh at the disaster: failing is part of the journey, and every crash is a funny story to tell.

Whether you want to prove your skill or just laugh at the chaos, Why Is Driving So Hard? invites you to take the wheel and discover that, in this world, driving is never as easy as it seems.
